g.text: PF-Q. Dates on which persistence was worse than GALE-CAST Model-W1 for both wind and MSLP: how many, and
Evidence E (panel directive). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
dates. Dates selected because persistence's wind and MSLP errors were both larger than GALE-CAST Model-W1's. GALE-CAST Model-W1 < persistence on these dates holds by
construction; climatology is not used to select.
Qualifying station-date: |persistence error| > |GALE-CAST Model-W1 error| for wind AND for MSLP (strict). Share = qualifying / station-dates with complete wind and MSLP. GALE-CAST Model-W1 = saved
neural-only next-day output (website scorecard cohort, target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30); persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-2020; truth = raw PAGASA
